newsitem.title: DENMARK: EU to rule on Carlsberg-Coke deal today.
newsitem.headline: EU to rule on Carlsberg-Coke deal today.

text.p: The European Commission was likely to decide on Friday if a proposed Nordic production and distribution deal between Danish brewer Carlsberg and beverage giant Coca-Cola complied with merger and monopoly rules.

A commission spokesman said in Brussels that a ruling on the probe was likely later in the day, although an announcement might be delayed as many people were away for a long weekend after the May Day holiday.
"We have not yet decided if we shall put out a press release today, but we may," he said.
Industry sources in Copenhagen fear that the commission will not give unqualified approval but will decide that more study of the deal and its implications for competition is necessary.

Carlsberg and Coca-Cola last March formed Coca-Cola Nordic Beverages, a joint venture to bottle, sell and distribute Coca-Cola and other soft drinks, initially in Denmark and Sweden, later in Norway and with Finland as a further goal. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
